kenshi: FY版ズレ: XBRL財務系列の最新はFY2025(2025-03-31)。hits/定性はFY2026 20-F(2026-03-31・総売上$20,158M)版。機械値(roic/accr等)はFY2025 XBRL基準、定性はFY2026原本基準
acc修正: ドラフトacc='usgaap'は誤り。XBRL名前空間=ifrs-full、hitsに'Non-IFRS measures'/'IFRIC'/'ifrs-full:CostOfSalesMember'→IFRS報告につきacc='ifrs'に訂正
通貨: 全系列USD建て(RevenueFromContractsWithCustomers[USD]等)で一貫。機能通貨はINRだがSEC XBRLはUSD換算・COP/BRL級の別通貨混入なし。hits: USD建て売上62.9%/EUR17.4%/AUD4.6%/GBP4.5%(FY2026)
roicg=25.7は独立再現不能(のれん込み+別調整のフェッチャ値と推定)だが検証済ROIC帯25-32%内のため維持
nde検算: (借入0+0-現金2,861M)/EBITDA≈-0.62 ≒ ドラフト-0.7(STI含めば更に純現金側)。借入ゼロ・純現金で整合
accr検算: (NI3,162-OCF4,351)/資産17,419=-6.8% ✓ ドラフト一致
gm/gmt充填: フェッチャはrev='1年分'でgm未算。kenshi全系列よりgm=GrossProfit5.9B/Rev19.3B≈30.6%(FY2025)。5年34.6→32.5→30.2→30.1→30.6%で緩やか低下→gmt='down'(gp系列0.1B丸めで±1pt誤差)
cagr充填: 売上CAGR FY2020→2025(12.8→19.3B USD)=8.6%。直近2年は18.6→19.3B(約+4%)で顕著に鈍化(成長鈍化テーマ整合)
ni充填: FY2025 ProfitLoss=3,162M(親会社帰属3,158M)→ni=3.2B USD。eps検算=3,158M/4,153M株=$0.76 ✓ ドラフト一致
sbc充填: 従業員株式報酬FY2025=95M USD(売上比0.5%)→sbc≈0.1B。dilNet-0.39(株数4,356M(2019)→4,055M(2026)純減=自社株買いが希薄化を上回る)と整合
fcf棄却(null): capexタグ(PurchaseOfPPE...)がFY2020で途切れFY2025値なし。kenshi既定のcapex=0→FCF=OCF4,351M=NIの138%は過大で再現不能。参考: 歴史的capex$350-465M/年→FCF実勢≈3.9B・転換>110%だが原本要
2026-07-19 発見度実データ: analysts=13 instOwn=12.065(AV)

evidence.dom: 『Intense competition in the market for technology services could affect our win rates and pricing, which could reduce our market share』+『Advances in cloud, AI and platform architectures have lowered barriers to entry, enabling niche providers』→世界ITサービスは断片化・Infosys世界シェア<10%=競争<40%=50
evidence.irr: 『Our profitability could be affected by pricing pressures on our services due to AI led compression, clients moving the work to offshore based GCCs』→顧客が内製GCCへ移行可能=代替容易=50
evidence.rep: 『Advances in cloud, AI and platform architectures have lowered barriers to entry, enabling niche providers to offer focused solutions』→数年で追随可=35
evidence.dur: スイッチングコスト型(顧客業務組込・ドメイン知識)だが『lowered barriers to entry』で減衰中=75
evidence.erosion: 『such centers may also result in erosion of some addressable market and/or increasing pricing pressures for our business』+『pricing pressures on our services due to AI led compression』→現在進行=active
evidence.disrupt: 『the AI disruptions have led us to deviate from our』+『pricing pressures on our services due to AI led compression, clients moving the work to offshore based GCCs』→AI代替は現在の脅威=threat
evidence.expiry: 限セクション『ヒットなし』・コンセッション/特許束依存なし=no
evidence.moatdecay: 『Advances in cloud, AI and platform architectures have lowered barriers to entry』+AI圧縮でシェア/価格浸食→堀の減衰=yes
evidence.geopol: 『In fiscal 2026, 56.1%, 32.1% and 8.9% of our revenues were derived from projects in North America, Europe and the Rest of the World』+『U.S. dollar denominated revenues represented 62.9% and 64.2% of total revenues』→北米56%集中+INR原価/USD収益ミスマッチ=中=1。米ビザ/移民政策リスクはhits内に証拠なく加点せず
evidence.p2: 営利FY2020 2,724M→FY2021 3,325M(COVID下+22%・ドローダウンなし)=浅い。ただし8年XBRLに景気後退1回のみ(GFC期は範囲外・ITサービス歴史的循環性未検証)につき80
evidence.p3: 純負債マイナス(nde-0.62〜-0.7)・借入ゼロ・現金2,861M+多額STI=純現金=95
evidence.p4: accr=-6.8%(<0)+『material weakness』ヒットは監査ICFR定型文(『assessing the risk that a material weakness exists』)で実指摘ではない・『Unresolved Staff Comments』は項目見出しのみ=90
evidence.f1: ΔNOPAT(FY2023→25)僅少(営利3,825→4,071M)=成長鈍化。ROIICは現金除きICで≈15-18%・総資本ベースで≈8%と幅大で再現困難。純現金・自社株買い・ROIC28%の還元の質で75
evidence.f2: 『incremental AI first services opportunity of USD 300-400 billion by 2030 as per market estimates』→浸透率は低位だが『erosion of some addressable market』でTAM自体が浸食されるため保守75
evidence.f3: 『our ability to maintain our competitive position, market share and revenues depends on...』+シェア浸食圧力(win rates低下リスク)+R&Dは非差別化=両符号弱=55(顧客集中top5=12.9%は低位で-10適用せず)
evidence.f4: 『we also generate revenues from products and platforms, which represented 4.8% and 4.7% of our total revenues』→隣接(製品/プラットフォーム・Topaz)売上5%未満で育成中=60
evidence.f5: disrupt=threat連動→45(AI-first/Topaz積極転換は部分的緩和材料だが脅威を覆すには不十分で加点せず)
evidence.roicg: 機械算出 2025年: NOPAT ÷ (自己資本 11,255,000,000 + 有利子負債 0)＝のれん込み。roic(除外)との差が買収規律の指標。**有利子負債タグ不在＝0扱いのため過大の可能性あり（要原本確認）**
